abilities.name: Ride-By
abilities.description: Krennik ignores difficult terrain, and opportunity attacks against it are made with disadvantage.

abilities.name: Mounted Agility
abilities.description: As a bonus action, Krennik takes the Dash or Disengage action.

abilities.name: Blood-Scent Gallop (1/Day) (Bonus Action)
abilities.description: Immediately after dealing damage to a creature that has half of its hit points or fewer, Krennik moves up to half its speed, and it makes one Bearded Axe attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Krennik makes two attacks: one with Bearded Axe and one with Javelin.

actions.name: Bearded Axe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage. If Krennik moved at least 20 feet in a straight line toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 4 (1d8) slashing damage and, if it is Medium or smaller, is knocked prone.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Trample Through (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Krennik moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks and can move through the spaces of Medium or smaller creatures. Each creature whose space it enters is targeted once by the following effect. Each creature whose space it enters must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 24 (7d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

other_edition.name: Krennik Skullstandard

Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. 12 (2d8 + 3) Slashing damage. If Krennik moved at least 20 feet in a straight line toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 4 (1d8) Slashing damage and, if it is Medium or smaller, has the Prone condition.

Actions.name: Javelin

Actions.text: Krennik moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and can move through the spaces of Medium or smaller creatures. Each creature whose space it enters is targeted once by the following effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 13. *Failure:* 24 (7d6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition.

Bonus Actions.name: Mounted Agility
Bonus Actions.text: Krennik takes the Dash or Disengage action.

Bonus Actions.name: Blood-Scent Gallop (1/Day)

other_edition.lore: A border-raider captain who welded his warband's skulls to an iron standard and swore the old road would pay him toll until the last traveler stopped straying from the fires.
